title: Amber Projection Manifest
description: A rebuildable read-only projection manifest. Projections (Governance Graph, Governed Knowledge Base, Visualization Workbench) are derived from canonical Amber artifacts and are never canonical authority. Field names follow ADR-0012 amendment E: projection_type, projection_version, rebuild_checkpoint, plus the four ADR-0012 versioning fields (amber_protocol_version, artifact_sequence, created_at, artifact_type). See ADR-0019 D5 and the distributed-governance baseline.

projectionId.description: Stable kebab-case identifier for this projection instance.

projection_type.description: Projection kind. Reserved by ADR-0012 amendment E.

projection_version.description: Projection schema version. Bump on breaking output-shape changes. Reserved by ADR-0012 amendment E.

rebuild_checkpoint.description: Deterministic anchor identifying the canonical state this projection was built from. Reserved by ADR-0012 amendment E.

sourceHash.description: Hash of the canonical artifacts this projection was built from.

outputHash.description: Hash of the projection output, for drift detection.

rebuiltAt.description: When the projection was last rebuilt.

amber_protocol_version.description: ADR-0012 versioning field: the Amber package version that produced or last touched this artifact. Optional.

artifact_sequence.description: ADR-0012 versioning field: monotonically-increasing sequence number within the artifact's identity scope. Optional.

created_at.description: ADR-0012 versioning field: ISO 8601 timestamp of first creation. Optional.

artifact_type.description: ADR-0012 versioning field: stable discriminant, e.g. "projection-manifest". Optional.
